method: Complete reads of ten pinned blobs, including empty package marker and README symlink blob; verified Git identities and SHA256. Original tree generator executed with counting stubs at depth two; no filesystem load test or upstream suite run.
findings: The nominal 8M test creates 8396800 directory entries at depth ten: 2099200 regular-file creations and 6297600 hardlinks. Its footer assertion adds duplicate count and group count, checking aggregate entries, not path membership or measured memory. ENOSPC turns setup into a skip.

Two smaller many-file tests each generate 98307 regular files and assert only output record count. Long-path variant budgets up to min(1024, PC_PATH_MAX), subtracts test-root prefix and splits remaining length into four components; it does not exercise paths beyond 1024 or arbitrary component limits.

SCons test launcher inherits environment, resolves pytest from PATH, splits PYTEST_ARGS with shlex and propagates a nonzero pytest result. It supplies a persistent RM_TS_DIR default /tmp/rmlint-tests. No subprocess timeout is set here.

Dependencies constrain major versions rather than exact builds. README blob is a symlink to ../docs/testing.rst; reading that link text does not credit the target document, which remains unread in this audit.

Help/man tests assert a few strings, with manpage marker; color tests check absent ANSI sequences and expected error status. They do not exercise arbitrary malformed escape strings previously identified in logger review.

Backup test checks ten repeated writes produce two results and that existing directory entries have allowed names/timestamp prefixes. It does not assert number of backup files or validate prior report contents.

executed_control.scope: Original generator with counters replacing file/link/directory creation; validates fixture cardinality only.

limits: No measured throughput or peak-memory result.
No production change; 88 of 289 tracked blobs reviewed, repository incomplete.
